title: "Your certificate"

<div data-pen-certificate-gate>

Your certificate unlocks once you have completed Modules 1–3.

<p data-pen-count-series class="meta-text">Loading your progress…</p>

[Go to the modules](index.qmd#modules){.btn .btn-primary role="button"}

</div>

<div data-pen-certificate-body class="is-hidden">

Congratulations, you've completed all three PEN modules. Type your name below,
choose a layout, then print or save this page as a PDF to keep your certificate.

```{=html}
<!-- Certificate type: Cinzel (engraved capitals), Cormorant Garamond (name,
     date), EB Garamond (sentences). Used on the certificate sheet only; the
     page around it stays in Bitter. -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@600;700&family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@1,600&family=EB+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;1,400&display=swap">

<div class="certificate-controls">
  <div class="certificate-field">
    <label for="pen-cert-name">Name for your certificate</label>
    <input type="text" id="pen-cert-name" data-pen-name-input placeholder="Type your name" autocomplete="name" />
  </div>
  <fieldset class="certificate-layout">
    <legend>Layout</legend>
    <label><input type="radio" name="pen-cert-layout" value="landscape" data-pen-cert-layout checked> Landscape</label>
    <label><input type="radio" name="pen-cert-layout" value="portrait" data-pen-cert-layout> Portrait</label>
  </fieldset>
  <button type="button" onclick="penPrintCertificate()" class="btn btn-primary">Print or save as PDF</button>
</div>

<div class="cert-stage" data-pen-cert-stage>
<div class="cert-paper is-landscape" data-pen-cert-paper>

<!-- Shared pattern and corner art. Kept in its own always-rendered SVG:
     a pattern inside an SVG that is display:none does not paint. -->
<svg class="cert-defs" width="0" height="0" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
  <defs>
    <pattern id="cert-ring-h" width="11" height="22" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><circle class="cert-hair" cx="5.5" cy="11" r="9.5"/></pattern>
    <pattern id="cert-ring-v" width="22" height="11" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><circle class="cert-hair" cx="11" cy="5.5" r="9.5"/></pattern>
    <g id="cert-corner">
      <rect class="cert-corner-out" x="-13" y="-13" width="26" height="26" transform="rotate(45)"/>
      <rect class="cert-corner-in" x="-7" y="-7" width="14" height="14" transform="rotate(45)"/>
    </g>
  </defs>
</svg>

<svg class="cert-frame cert-frame-landscape" viewBox="0 0 1056 816" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
  <defs>
    <clipPath id="cert-band-l"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M34 34H1022V782H34Z M56 56V760H1000V56Z"/></clipPath>
  </defs>
  <rect class="cert-rule-heavy" x="26" y="26" width="1004" height="764"/>
  <g clip-path="url(#cert-band-l)">
    <rect x="34" y="34" width="988" height="22" fill="url(#cert-ring-h)"/>
    <rect x="34" y="760" width="988" height="22" fill="url(#cert-ring-h)"/>
    <rect x="34" y="34" width="22" height="748" fill="url(#cert-ring-v)"/>
    <rect x="1000" y="34" width="22" height="748" fill="url(#cert-ring-v)"/>
  </g>
  <rect class="cert-rule-thin" x="34" y="34" width="988" height="748"/>
  <rect class="cert-rule-thin" x="56" y="56" width="944" height="704"/>
  <rect class="cert-rule-accent" x="64" y="64" width="928" height="688"/>
  <use href="#cert-corner" x="45" y="45"/><use href="#cert-corner" x="1011" y="45"/>
  <use href="#cert-corner" x="45" y="771"/><use href="#cert-corner" x="1011" y="771"/>
</svg>

<svg class="cert-frame cert-frame-portrait" viewBox="0 0 816 1056" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
  <defs>
    <clipPath id="cert-band-p"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M34 34H782V1022H34Z M56 56V1000H760V56Z"/></clipPath>
  </defs>
  <rect class="cert-rule-heavy" x="26" y="26" width="764" height="1004"/>
  <g clip-path="url(#cert-band-p)">
    <rect x="34" y="34" width="748" height="22" fill="url(#cert-ring-h)"/>
    <rect x="34" y="1000" width="748" height="22" fill="url(#cert-ring-h)"/>
    <rect x="34" y="34" width="22" height="988" fill="url(#cert-ring-v)"/>
    <rect x="760" y="34" width="22" height="988" fill="url(#cert-ring-v)"/>
  </g>
  <rect class="cert-rule-thin" x="34" y="34" width="748" height="988"/>
  <rect class="cert-rule-thin" x="56" y="56" width="704" height="944"/>
  <rect class="cert-rule-accent" x="64" y="64" width="688" height="928"/>
  <use href="#cert-corner" x="45" y="45"/><use href="#cert-corner" x="771" y="45"/>
  <use href="#cert-corner" x="45" y="1011"/><use href="#cert-corner" x="771" y="1011"/>
</svg>

<div class="cert-content">
  <p class="cert-org">Participation Equity Navigator &middot; ADA-PARC</p>
  <h2 class="cert-title"><span class="cert-title-main">Certificate</span> <span class="cert-title-sub">of Completion</span></h2>
  <svg class="cert-flourish" width="260" height="16" viewBox="0 0 260 16" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
    <path class="cert-flourish-line" d="M0 8H104M156 8H260"/>

  </svg>

  <p class="cert-name" data-pen-name-output>Your name here</p>
  <p class="cert-statement">has completed the three online modules of the PEN training, <em>Getting Started, ADA Insights</em>; <em>Exploring ADA-PARC Website &amp; Data</em>; and <em>Making Sense of Data</em>.</p>
  <div class="cert-bottom">
    <div class="cert-sig cert-signer">
      <div class="cert-sig-space"></div>
      <div class="cert-sig-line"><p class="cert-sig-name">Joy Hammel</p><p class="cert-sig-label">Principal Investigator, ADA-PARC</p></div>
    </div>

  </div>
  <p class="cert-foot">Covers the online portion of PEN. The in-person training completes it.</p>

</div>

</div>
</div>
```
